title: Don Toliver Hits the ‘Nitrous,’ Readies Second Album for 2026: ‘Press the Button’
summary: The Cactus Jack rapper will make his Saturday Night Live debut on Dec. 5. following Nitrous' arrival.
contentText:
After earning his first No. 1 album atop the Billboard 200 with January’s OCTANE , Don Toliver is spinning the block for round two before the year expires with Nitrous .

Toliver announced on Tuesday (Nov. 17) that the LP is set to arrive on Dec. 4. The Cactus Jack rapper released a trailer to accompany the announcement, which saw him reveal that the project is entirely produced by Toliver himself.

“PRESS THE BUTTON,” he captioned the teaser. “NITROUS 12.04.26 RECORDED, PRODUCED + ENGINEERED BY DON TOLIVER. PRE-ORDER ON DONTOLIVER.COM NOW. SNL 12.05.26 BTW…WHIP TESTED ON THE AUTOBAHN. SEE YOU IN 2 WEEKS.”

Soundtracked by a dance-leaning snippet, the trailer finds Toliver turning an all-white space in Stuttgart, Germany, into a recording studio, and he’s the mad scientist at the helm. DT leans on a similar aesthetic to what he implemented during his time at the Mount Wilson Observatory for OCTANE .

View this post on Instagram

The 32-year-old had been teasing Nitrous while on the road for his Octane World Tour throughout the summer. He unleashed the project’s lead single with “Party With the Boys” on Nov. 13, which features an appearance from Jackass star Bam Margera in the music video.

OCTANE arrived in January and topped the Billboard 200 with 125,000 total album-equivalent units. The project currently sits at No. 23 on the chart and hasn’t left the Billboard 200 since entering 41 weeks ago.

Toliver will look to join a rare club of rappers to notch two No. 1 albums on the Billboard 200 in the same year, which includes DMX, Future, 2Pac and NBA YoungBoy.

The Recording Academy took note of Toliver’s massive year, as he’s the most-nominated rapper at the 2027 Grammy Awards with five nods. He’s up for best rap album ( OCTANE ), best rap song (“E85”), best rap performance (“Body”) and best melodic rap performance (“E85”).

Following the arrival of Nitrous , Don Toliver will make his Saturday Night Live debut on Dec. 5 as the episode’s musical guest.
